name: Javier Ramirez
bio:
Javier's passion for motorsport ignited in his youth, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He started his career as a junior engineer at a small Chilean racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp technical mind and innovative ideas. Before transitioning to a sporting director role, he spent time as a race engineer and chief strategist, developing a keen understanding of race dynamics and team management.

Javier is known for his ability to foster a collaborative and driven environment. He is a firm believer in empowering his team members and encouraging creative problem-solving. His strategic brilliance, coupled with his approachable leadership style, makes him a highly sought-after sporting director. Javier's distinctive trait is his ability to anticipate and adapt to changing race conditions, consistently making crucial decisions that provide a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Javier is of average height, with a focused gaze and a warm smile that reflects his approachable nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and race strategies.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific type of Chilean coffee before every race.
